# Fewwords

> Close your tabs, keep the insight. Paste a URL, get the gist in 60 seconds.

Fewwords is the "tab graveyard" antidote. It’s an AI-powered content summarization service built for people who have 20+ unread tabs and know they’ll never get to them. It works on articles, YouTube videos, and Reddit threads—anything with a URL.

The goal is simple: skip the fluff, skip the 20-minute intros, and get the actual value in a readable, bulleted format. No "AI-speak," no weird formatting, just the takeaways you actually need.

## Why use Fewwords instead of ChatGPT?
- **No Copy-Pasting:** You don't copy text anymore. Just grab the URL and you're done.
- **No Prompt Engineering:** You don't have to write "summarize this" anymore. It already knows the best strategy for the specific content type (article vs video vs thread).
- **Shareable Insights:** Summaries are clean and shareable via link. Your friends don't even need an account to read them.

## Key Features
- **URL-to-Insight:** Paste a link, get a summary in ~60 seconds.
- **Multi-Format Support:** Works on blogs, YouTube videos, and Reddit posts.
- **Personal Library:** Save summaries to your own collection to reference later.
- **Bookmarklet:** One-click summarization from any page you're reading.

## Core Links
- [Home](https://fewwords.app): The main dashboard to paste URLs and start summarising.
- [Explore](https://fewwords.app/explore): See what others are reading and get the gist of trending content.
- [About](https://fewwords.app/about): The philosophy behind fighting information overload.
- [Library](https://fewwords.app/library): Your personal collection of insights and saved tabs (requires login).

## Optional
- [Settings](https://fewwords.app/settings): Manage your account and preferences.
- [Demo](https://fewwords.app/demo): See a live example of how it transforms long content into quick wins.
